# Privacy Notice

Effective from 4 June 2025 · ON3 WORKS LTD

## 1\. Introduction

At hiron.ai, we are committed to protecting your privacy and personal data. This Privacy Notice explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you use our services.

## 2\. Information We Collect

### Personal Information

- Name and contact information
- Professional experience and skills
- Education and qualifications
- Employment preferences

### Technical Information

- IP address and device information
- Browser type and version
- Usage patterns and preferences

## 3\. How We Use Your Information

- To provide and improve our job matching services
- To communicate with you about opportunities
- To analyze and enhance our platform performance
- To comply with legal obligations

## 4\. Contact Methods

We may contact you by the following methods for recruitment-related communications:

- **Email:** We will send you emails regarding job opportunities, application updates, messages from recruiters, and platform notifications. You can manage email preferences in your account settings.
- **WhatsApp:** If you provide a phone number, we may contact you via WhatsApp for recruitment-related communications, including job opportunities and scheduling.
- **Phone:** We may contact you by phone call to discuss opportunities, verify information, or arrange interviews.

You can update your contact preferences or opt out of certain channels in your account settings. Note that opting out of essential communications may affect our ability to provide our services to you.

## 5\. AI and Automated Processing

We use artificial intelligence (AI) to process your information and improve our services:

- **Resume extraction:** When you upload your resume (PDF), we use AI services (including Google Gemini and OpenAI) to automatically extract and structure information such as your name, contact details, work experience, education, skills, and qualifications. This helps us create and maintain your candidate profile.
- **Job matching:** We use AI and machine learning (including vector embeddings and services from Cohere) to match your profile with relevant job opportunities and to help recruiters find suitable candidates.
- **Accuracy:** While we strive for accuracy, AI extraction may occasionally make errors. Please review and correct any extracted information during profile verification.

## 6\. Data Sharing with Employers and Recruiters

We may share your information with:

- **Potential employers:** When you are matched with or apply to a role, we may share your profile, resume, and relevant information with the employer or their designated recruiters.
- **Recruiters:** Verified recruiters on our platform may view your profile (subject to your visibility settings) and contact you about opportunities.
- **Consultancy partners:** In some cases, we may share your candidate report and resume with external consultancy partners to facilitate placement. This sharing is done in connection with specific recruitment opportunities.
- **Service providers:** Who help us operate our platform.
- **Legal authorities:** When required by law.

We only share your data with employers and recruiters in accordance with your preferences and this Privacy Notice. You can withdraw consent for certain sharing in your account settings, subject to our ability to fulfil existing commitments.

## 7\. Third-Party Processors

We use the following third-party services to operate our platform. Each processes personal data on our behalf under data processing agreements:

| Processor | Purpose | Data Shared |
| --- | --- | --- |
| AWS Cognito | User authentication and account management | Email, password (hashed), phone |
| Supabase | Database and file storage | All profile data, resumes (PDFs) |
| Resend | Transactional and notification emails | Email address, name, message content |
| Milvus/Zilliz | Vector database for AI matching | Profile embeddings (derived from your data) |
| Cohere | AI embeddings for job matching | Profile text (skills, experience, etc.) |
| OpenAI | Resume extraction (fallback) | Resume content |
| Google (Gemini) | Resume extraction | Resume content |
| Unipile | LinkedIn messaging integration | LinkedIn messages, profile identifiers |

## 8\. Resume Storage

When you upload a resume (PDF), we store it securely in cloud storage (Supabase). Your resume is used to:

- Build and update your candidate profile
- Share with recruiters and employers when you are matched with or apply to opportunities
- Support our AI matching and recruitment processes

Resumes are retained in accordance with our Data Retention policy.

## 9\. Vector Embeddings

We create mathematical representations (embeddings) of your profile data (e.g. skills, experience, education) for our AI-powered job matching. These embeddings are stored in a vector database (Milvus/Zilliz) and used to match you with relevant opportunities. They do not contain your raw personal data in readable form but are derived from it.

## 10\. Profile Visibility

You can control who sees your profile through the following visibility settings:

- **Public:** Your profile may be visible to a broader audience for job matching.
- **Recruiters only:** Your profile is visible only to verified recruiters and employers using our platform.
- **Private:** Your profile is hidden from searches; we will not share it with recruiters or employers without your explicit consent.

You can change your visibility at any time in your account settings. Your choice affects how recruiters and potential employers can discover and view your profile.

## 11\. Data Security

We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

## 12\. International Data Transfers

ON3 WORKS LTD is a UK company. Your data may be processed by service providers located in the European Union, United States, or other countries. Where we transfer data outside the UK, we ensure appropriate safeguards are in place, including:

- UK adequacy decisions (where the destination country is deemed adequate)
- Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) approved by the UK authorities
- Other mechanisms permitted under UK GDPR

You acknowledge that by using our services, your data may be transferred to and processed in these locations.

## 13\. Legal Basis (UK GDPR)

We process your personal data on the following legal bases:

- **Contract:** Processing necessary to provide our job matching and recruitment services.
- **Consent:** Where you have given explicit consent (e.g. marketing, certain data sharing, contact by WhatsApp/phone).
- **Legitimate interest:** To improve our platform, prevent fraud, and comply with legal obligations, where such interests are not overridden by your rights.

You have the right to withdraw consent where it applies, and to exercise your data protection rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection, portability, restriction) as set out in the "Your Rights" section of this Privacy Notice.

## 14\. Your Rights

Under applicable data protection laws, you have the right to:

- Access your personal data
- Correct inaccurate information
- Delete your data
- Object to processing
- Data portability
- Restrict processing

## 15\. Data Retention

We retain your personal data only for as long as necessary to provide our services and fulfill legal obligations.

## 16\. Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Notice or our data practices, please contact us at [privacy@hiron.ai](mailto:privacy@hiron.ai)
